title: Missing moeb tool: Bash
description: Used the Claude Code native Bash tool to run cargo build --release and cargo test from src/moeb/ for Step 7 compilation and test verification. No moeb shell execution tool exists in the moeb registry.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb equivalent of the Bash tool covering shell command execution for build and test verification (e.g., a run_command or cargo_build tool).
